_comment: The 'only when sure' rules for a GitOps add-on's seeded manifest (#6549), read by BOTH the runner's drift check (packages/core/provisioner/addons_gitops_bump_fixture_test.go) and the console's edit (apps/console/tests/lib/addons/gitops-bump/edit.test.ts). drift: does the runner report this file as behind. edit: what the console's edit does, 'ok' or its refusal. An edit is never 'ok' where drift is false. Every case installs chart ingress-nginx and the target version is 4.15.1.

cases.name: plain
cases.why: The seeded file, older chart: the one case the whole feature exists for.

cases.name: double-quoted
cases.why: A double-quoted version keeps its double quotes.

cases.name: single-quoted
cases.why: A single-quoted version keeps its single quotes.

cases.name: crlf-and-comments
cases.why: CRLF line endings, a header comment, an end-of-line comment on the version itself: all byte-identical.

cases.name: v-prefixed
cases.why: A v-prefixed older version is drift; the edit writes the catalog's spelling.

cases.name: equal
cases.why: Already on the target.

cases.name: newer
cases.why: The customer moved ahead of the catalog.

cases.name: range
cases.why: A range is the customer's choice.

cases.name: shorthand
cases.why: A two-part version is not a full SemVer version.

cases.name: leading-zero
cases.why: SemVer forbids leading zeros; golang.org/x/mod/semver rejects it.

cases.name: different-chart
cases.why: The customer replaced our chart.

cases.name: not-an-application
cases.why: Not an ArgoCD Application.

cases.name: not-yaml
cases.why: Does not parse.

cases.name: empty
cases.why: An empty file.

cases.name: duplicate-key
cases.why: Two targetRevision keys: neither reader picks one.

cases.name: invalid-utf8
cases.why: Not UTF-8.

cases.name: multi-document
cases.why: The runner reads the first document and warns; the edit refuses a file it did not seed whole.

cases.name: multi-source
cases.why: The runner reads spec.source; the edit refuses an Application that also has spec.sources.

cases.name: tagged
cases.why: An explicit tag: the customer shaped the scalar.

cases.name: block-scalar
cases.why: A block scalar: the value is a version, the text is not.

cases.name: anchor-alias
cases.why: An alias: editing it would change the anchor's other users.

cases.name: anchored-revision
cases.why: The version itself carries an anchor that an alias elsewhere reads: the edit would change that copy too, and a re-parse cannot tell.

cases.name: anchored-source
cases.why: The source block carries an anchor that an alias elsewhere reads: changing its version changes the alias's copy too.

cases.name: escaped-double-quoted
cases.why: An escape inside the quotes: the source text is not the value.

cases.name: byte-order-mark
cases.why: A UTF-8 byte-order mark.
